name: fake-mcp-server
description: E2E-only MCP server over streamable-http that stands in for a third-party MCP server (docs/adr/0045). It exposes a FIXED, deterministic tool set (echo, whoami, boom) so cluster e2e tests exercise the real mcp-broker and real engines end to end without a real external server. whoami reflects the inbound Bearer token, proving the broker forwarded the CALLER's per-user delegated token upstream. Never deployed outside the e2e overlay.
